Sandbox_Strogare_SortRadius_tooltip: How far from the player the sorter searches for assigned destination containers. Capped at 30 tiles.
Sandbox_Strogare_SortFloorRange_tooltip: How many floors above and below the player can be scanned. Capped at 2 floors.
Sandbox_Strogare_MaxItemsPerSort_tooltip: Maximum number of items processed in one sorting run. Run sorting again for very large storage rooms.
Sandbox_Strogare_IncludeOtherFloors_tool: Allow the sorter to search assigned containers above and below the player.
Sandbox_Strogare_IncludeVehicleContainer: Allow vehicle storage to be detected for category assignment and nearby scans.
Sandbox_Strogare_AllowVehicleSorting_too: Allow items to be moved from or into vehicle containers. Disabled by default for multiplayer safety.
Sandbox_Strogare_AdminOnly_tooltip: Restrict sorting commands to admins, moderators and overseers.
Sandbox_Strogare_DebugMode_tooltip: Print detailed diagnostic samples to the console. Keep disabled for normal servers.
Sandbox_Strogare_Language_tooltip: Language used by Strogare messages. Auto follows the game language when possible.
